rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both orders concern ceded Hawaiian public land needed by the Territory, recite that a transfer is desirable and in the public interest, transfer title to the Territory, insert extensive metes-and-bounds descriptions, and make the transfer subject to detailed conditions preserving federal interests. The child's conditions are much more elaborate and tailored to replacement of Army facilities, but the shared combination of title-transfer language, Hawaiian cession history, land-description format, and conditional federal-use machinery is concrete and distinctive. C13 and C17 are strong topical and linguistic comparators involving restoration of military or harbor land to Hawaii, but their operative machinery is substantially simpler.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a part of the public property originally ceded to the United States of America by the Republic of Hawaii, which cession was accepted by the joint resolution of annexation approved July 7, 1898
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel recital establishing the origin and status of Hawaiian public land.

shared_material.child_excerpt: it is deemed desirable and in the public interest that the possession, use, and control of the said portion be restored to the Territory of Hawaii, and that title thereto be transferred to said Territory
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it is deemed desirable and in the public interest that title to that portion hereinafter described be transferred to the Territory of Hawaii upon the conditions hereinafter stated
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel justification and title-transfer formulation, including an express conditional structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Upon the fulfillment of the conditions precedent specified in Part II ... title to the said tracts shall be transferred to the said Territory
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Title to the following-described tract of land ... is hereby transferred to the Territory of Hawaii ... This transfer is made subject to the following conditions
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same core administrative machinery: a described Hawaiian land transfer to the Territory constrained by enumerated conditions protecting federal interests.
